subject: 马厩
prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Reference shows exact footprint to occupy. Create a COMPACT, DEEP, nearly-square Chinese Southern Song stable with ONLY THREE front stall bays, each stall extending far backwards, plus a small open stone forecourt. Width9 metres and depth7 metres, ratio1.286. No very long roof, no fourth bay. Left-facing facade only slightly longer than right-facing side. CAMERA orthographic dimetric with BOTH ground edges exactly26.565degrees, slope+.500/-.500, no perspective. Trace reference footprint angles and proportions, do not alter. Realistic historic game sprite, Lin'an1223: handmade gray tiled simple gable roof, weathered timber posts/rails, plaster right side wall, some straw in stalls, one stone trough. Left-up screen light, short contact shadow lower-right. Flat rectangular ground base with all three visible ground CONTACT corners unobstructed, regular clean perimeter and very thin foundation. Centered entire uncropped standalone structure with transparent margins, TRUE transparent RGBA outside structure. Remove every guideline/grid and white background from reference. No people, horses, text, numbers, letters, banners, signs, modern elements, elaborate palace ornaments, thick diorama base, sky, landscape, big cast shadows. The roof and foundation must BOTH obey the broad deep9x7 proportion and TWO IDENTICAL axis angles.
negative: 文字、标牌字、水印、人物、天空、地平线、背景色、棋盘格、厚地台、大阴影、现代物、清代形制、透视消失点、裁切屋檐、卡通。

references.role: 占地线框几何参考；不作资产像素合成

created_time_basis: 生成后记录的接收/归档时间；非工具披露的服务端调用时间

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize; dimensions rounded to nearest px
paste without mask into transparent RGBA canvas; no repaint, warp, flip or alpha thresholding

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读可见底面边；±3px不确定性；非3D测绘，隐藏后角未直接测得。

notes: 入选：宽深恢复、双轴协调，原图已view_image与灰底alpha合成复核。 宋式灰瓦木构/灰石材质、左上光、无字无人无现代物，真实alpha，主体完整。底面读点来自实际接触边，未warp/拉伸；64×32叠合图另存review2。
